component_rules.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (#E5E5E5), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow. Use pure #FFFFFF for card background.
component_rules.buttons: Rectangular (rounded-none). Primary buttons use #002FA7 background with #FFFFFF text. Sharp edges. Hover state: #001F70.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: rounded-none, border-gray-200, focus:border-[#002FA7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#002FA7].
component_rules.kanban_board: Columns separated by 1px right border. Cards have strict geometric lines. No soft floating cards.
component_rules.tables: Minimalist, crisp headers. Border-bottom on rows, no vertical borders inside table cells. Use IBM Plex Mono for numeric data.

image_urls.description: Used for the split-screen Google Login page on the right side. Modern minimalist curved balconies.
Architectural blueprint abstract. Use as a subtle background (low opacity) in the Client Portal header or AI Chat widget.
Minimalist abstract sculpture. Can be used as a placeholder image for the AI assistant avatar or default project cover.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, stark and clear.

login.layout: 50/50 split screen. Left side stark white with login form vertically centered. Right side image full height.

crm_leads.layout: Horizontal scroll Kanban. Full height columns.

projects.layout: List view. Detail page features a horizontal scroll/stepper for Stage Progress Tracker.

invoices.layout: Strict black-and-white grid layout imitating a printed PDF. Clean tabular data.

client_portal.layout: Single clean column, shareable link style. Minimal navigation. Heavy focus on typography.

ai_assistant.layout: Floating chat widget in bottom right.

interactions.hover_states: Crisp transitions. bg color shifts and border color darkens. Lift cards using -translate-y-1.
interactions.focus_states: High contrast 2px solid ring (#002FA7) with 2px offset.
interactions.animations: Subtle, fast. 200ms ease. No bouncy effects.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA compliance. Black text on white/gray. White text on primary blue.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='login-google-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install recharts for the dashboard charts (Funnel, Heatmap).
Apply global styles in index.css: set font families and border radius variables to 0.
Shadcn components MUST be customized to use rounded-none and 1px borders.
Create the Client Portal as a separate layout without the main dashboard sidebar.
Use the provided image URLs exactly. Do not use generic placeholders.
